verses.text: Now the children of Israel, that dwelt in Judea, heard all that Holofernes the chief captain of Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians had done to the nations, and after what manner he had spoiled all their temples, and brought them to nought.
Therefore they were exceedingly afraid of him, and were troubled for Jerusalem, and for the temple of the Lord their God:
For they were newly come from the captivity, and all the people of Judea were lately gathered together: and the vessels, and the altar, and the house, were sanctified after the profanation.
Therefore they sent into all the coasts of Samaria, and the villages, and to Bethoron, and Belmen, and Jericho, and to Choba, and Esora, and to the valley of Salem:

And possessed themselves beforehand of all the tops of the high mountains, and fortified the villages that were in them, and laid up victuals for the provision of war: for their fields were of late reaped.
Also Joacim the high priest, which was in those days in Jerusalem, wrote to them that dwelt in Bethulia, and Betomestham, which is over against Esdraelon toward the open country, near to Dothaim,

Charging them to keep the passages of the hill country: for by them there was an entrance into Judea, and it was easy to stop them that would come up, because the passage was strait, for two men at the most.
And the children of Israel did as Joacim the high priest had commanded them, with the ancients of all the people of Israel.
Then every man of Israel cried to God with great fervency, and with great vehemency did they humble their souls:
Both they, and their wives, and their children, and their cattle, and every stranger and hireling, and their servants bought with money, put sackcloth upon their loins.

Thus every man and woman, and the little children, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, fell before the temple, and cast ashes upon their heads, and spread out their sackcloth before the face of the Lord:

Also they put sackcloth about the altar, and cried to the God of Israel all with one consent earnestly, that he would not give their children for a prey, and their wives for a spoil, and the cities of their inheritance to destruction, and the sanctuary to profanation and reproach, and for the nations to rejoice at.
So Joacim the high priest went about all Israel, and spake to them,
Saying, Know ye that the Lord will hear your prayers, if ye continue stedfast in fasting and prayers in the sight of the Lord.

Remember Moses the servant of the Lord, who overcame Amalec, that trusted in his own power, and in his own army, and in his own might, and in his own horses, and in his own chariots, and in his own horsemen, not by fighting with the sword, but by holy prayers.
So shall all the enemies of Israel be, if ye persevere in this work that ye have begun.
So they besought the Lord, and continued still in his sight.

And all they that served the Lord, and they that ministered unto the Lord, and they that ministered before the altar of the Lord, with their holy vestments, and with their linen vestments, cried unto the Lord.
